story.title: The Gravity Debt
story.logline: A man discovers his shadow has been paying rent to the city for years, and now his balance is due.
story.twist: The shadow wasn't paying rent for him; it was paying rent to keep him anchored to the ground.
story.ending: If I stop paying today, do I finally get to fly, or do I simply vanish?

scenes.narration: My shadow just walked away from my feet and left an eviction notice taped to the pavement.
scenes.visual_prompt: Vertical 9:16. Leo, a 25-year-old man with messy dark hair and a worn denim jacket, stares down at a glowing paper on the gray concrete sidewalk in a neon-lit alley.
scenes.camera: Extreme close-up on the glowing paper, pans up to Leo's shocked face.

scenes.narration: I chased it down three neon-drenched blocks, but it moved faster than any normal human silhouette could.
scenes.visual_prompt: Vertical 9:16. Leo, 25, messy dark hair, worn denim jacket, sprinting frantically through a narrow, neon-lit alleyway, chasing a darting dark shape.
scenes.camera: Tracking shot from behind Leo, high speed, shaky.

scenes.narration: It stopped outside a towering glass bank, sliding right under the heavy doors like spilled black ink.
scenes.visual_prompt: Vertical 9:16. Leo, 25, messy dark hair, worn denim jacket, halting outside a massive skyscraper with glowing glass doors in a neon alley.
scenes.camera: Low angle looking up at Leo against the towering building.

scenes.narration: I slipped inside behind a midnight clerk and found my shadow standing at a glowing ATM machine.
scenes.visual_prompt: Vertical 9:16. Leo, 25, messy dark hair, worn denim jacket, peering cautiously into a sterile, futuristic bank lobby illuminated by blue screens.
scenes.camera: Medium shot, over Leo's shoulder looking at a dark silhouette typing on a screen.

scenes.narration: The screen flashed red with a staggering balance. Seven years of ground-rent, billed directly to my feet.
scenes.visual_prompt: Vertical 9:16. Leo, 25, messy dark hair, worn denim jacket, staring wide-eyed at a massive floating red holographic screen showing digits.
scenes.camera: Close-up on Leo's reflecting eyes, then to the glowing red numbers.

scenes.narration: That is when the dark shape turned around, revealing it had my face carved into its chest.
scenes.visual_prompt: Vertical 9:16. Leo, 25, messy dark hair, worn denim jacket, facing a pitch-black humanoid silhouette that has a glowing outline of Leo's face on its torso.
scenes.camera: Push in slowly on Leo's terrified expression.

scenes.narration: It whispered that without its daily payments to the city core, my feet would lose their grip.
scenes.visual_prompt: Vertical 9:16. Leo, 25, messy dark hair, worn denim jacket, backing away slowly as the silhouette points a dark hand toward the ground.
scenes.camera: Medium wide shot, showing Leo trembling in the sterile lobby.

scenes.narration: Gravity isn't a natural law here. It is a subscription service, and my account is currently overdrawn.
scenes.visual_prompt: Vertical 9:16. Leo, 25, messy dark hair, worn denim jacket, looking down at his sneakers as they literally begin to lift a fraction of an inch off the floor.
scenes.camera: Low angle tracking feet losing contact with the tile.

scenes.narration: My heels floated upward into the empty air, untethered and weightless inside the silent bank vault.
scenes.visual_prompt: Vertical 9:16. Leo, 25, messy dark hair, worn denim jacket, now floating upside down near the high ceiling, clawing desperately at the smooth walls.
scenes.camera: Wide overhead shot looking straight down at Leo drifting away.

scenes.narration: If I stop paying today, do I finally get to fly, or do I simply vanish?
scenes.visual_prompt: Vertical 9:16. Leo, 25, messy dark hair, worn denim jacket, reaching his hand toward the floor one last time as the neon lights fade below him.
scenes.camera: Extreme close-up on Leo's outstretched fingertips, then fading to black.

caption.hook: Your shadow isn't yours for free.
caption.title: The Gravity Debt
caption.caption:
For years, someone else has been paying the city to keep you grounded. But when the balance hits zero, you realize what actually keeps you attached to the Earth.

Would you pay the price to stay heavy?
